# AnkiDroid API source vendor

This directory records the source-only API surface copied into the app from
AnkiDroid `v2.24.0` at commit
`ebcf8e0e34921628b9b8a496c66ffd4adbb3705f`. The generated Kotlin source lives
under `app/src/main/ankidroidApi/kotlin`; the complete upstream LGPLv3 and GPLv3
texts live under `upstream/`. `manifest.json` records the upstream path,
destination path, byte count, SHA-256 and SPDX license expression for every
vendored file.

The generated tree contains exactly the seven files in AnkiDroid's `api`
module which define its client contract. It contains no provider, collection,
database or UI implementation. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/ichi2/anki/api/BuildConfig.kt`
is a separate hand-owned compatibility shim with only the release authority
and permission constants formerly generated by AnkiDroid's library build.

Do not hand-edit generated files. Refresh from a clean checkout which proves
the pinned tag and commit. The tool rejects hidden index flags and worktree
divergence, then reads only exact `100644 blob` objects from the pinned commit;
mutable worktree bytes never drive generated output. The checkout must not
overlap a managed output tree:

```bash
python3.13 tools/ankidroid-api/sync_ankidroid_api.py \
  --refresh --source /path/to/Anki-Android
```

The normal offline check hashes committed output against the committed
manifest. It does not claim comparison with upstream:

```bash
python3.13 tools/ankidroid-api/sync_ankidroid_api.py --check
```

Run the explicitly named provenance mode when the independently verified
checkout is available. This compares generated bytes with the immutable blobs
from the pinned Git tree:

```bash
python3.13 tools/ankidroid-api/sync_ankidroid_api.py \
  --check-upstream --source /path/to/Anki-Android
```

The same opt-in proof joins `scripts/health.sh` when
`ANKIDROID_API_UPSTREAM_CHECKOUT=/path/to/Anki-Android` is set. Without that
variable, health stays clone-free and makes only the manifest integrity claim.

See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for component notices and
[RELINKING.md](RELINKING.md) for the source, rebuild and installation
assessment.
